name: Lash icon
description: UI slot icon for the mandible lash. Composes the real `ss.proj.slash` arc via `use` at a quarter scale, so retuning the weapon's sweep restyles its icon in the same edit. Rim is `$white` — the bone the mandible is, bleached. It was `$husk`, three quarters of what this icon draws, until the Pulse Rate passive that wears this rim had to read as white beside the Shell's grey; the mandible inside keeps its husk, so the rim is the bone a step whiter rather than a colour from somewhere else.

evolved.description: Cowboy. The rim goes gold, and the crescent closes into what the evolution does: one tapered stroke most of the way round the centre, hair-thin at the tail and full at a rounded head, with the frost edge riding the last half turn. One shape, not the slash composed twice — two crescents at 32px read as an eye or a pair of moons, where a single swoosh that nearly closes reads as a turn. Drawn in the slot rather than composed because `ss.proj.slash` is a 200° cut; the evolution is the thing that sweep never is, the whole circle.
